title: daimonionnn/ik-llama-toolkit
summary: ik-llama-toolkit是一个用于运行大型语言模型的命令行推理服务器和基准测试工具，适用于GPU VRAM不足的情况。针对RTX PRO 6000和Deepseek v4闪存进行优化，支持大型模型的高效推理和性能测试。
description: A one-command inference server and benchmark harness for running large language models that don't fit in your GPU's VRAM. Optimized for RTX PRO 6000 and Deepseek v4 flash
